precisionConventions.Zenodo: publication_date, always a full day — it dates the DEPOSIT, not always the object.
precisionConventions.National Gallery: yearFrom/yearTo, whole years. Honest: across 2779 dated archive records none sits on 07-15 and only three on 01-01, so a day given here is a real day.
precisionConventions.Wikimedia Commons: a literal QuickStatements qualifier (+1971-01-00T00:00:00Z/10) — Wikidata's integer ladder, 11 day / 10 month / 9 year, declared rather than inferred.
precisionConventions.Wikidata: explicit integer precision. Raw JSON zero-fills, SPARQL start-pads: same fact, two paddings, one declared precision.
precisionConventions.MusicBrainz: release dates only. The eleven tape titles all report 2002, which is the CD, so they are written here with NO date rather than a confident wrong one.
precisionConventions.archive.org: no precision field, and the item's date describes the upload rather than the work — so it is not used as a date at all. Year evidence comes from the filename.
precisionConventions.National Library: a one-letter flag per row, p for day and k for month, and the k rows are start-padded to day 01 — indistinguishable from an attested 1st without the flag.
precisionConventions.lahteilla.fi: an archivist writing Finnish, in eleven forms counted rather than remembered: 1953 · 1953-04-07 · 30-06-1975 (DAY FIRST, and only the position of the four-digit number tells it from the ISO form) · 1976-11 · 1950-luku (the decade) · 1950-luvun puoliväli (mid-decade) · 1960-luvun alku (early) · 1960-luku, loppupuoli (late) · 1975 jälkeen (after 1975) · 1963-2005 (a span) · 1992-00-00 (a zero month and day, which is an EXPLICIT not-known and not a January the 0th). The qualified decades keep the WHOLE decade as their bracket and carry the qualifier in words: "mid" has no defined width, and inventing one would put a number in this file that the archivist never wrote.
precisionConventions.Crossref: the registered date is 2015-09-11 for all 36 parts, which is the day the book came out — so for the twenty chapters that are HIS OWN TEXTS the date used here is the year the editors printed in the chapter title (Audio Diary C4008-1 (1971)), which is a statement about the document made by people who had the manuscript. "ca." in a title is recorded as the editors' estimate.
precisionConventions.Discogs: a year integer and nothing finer. A `master` year is the EARLIEST of its versions rather than any one pressing, which the row says.
precisionConventions.OpenAlex: publication_date, a full day where the publisher registered one and a bare year where it did not — the precision follows the length of the string, not a default.
precisionConventions.ERR (for contrast, not a source here): year-only dates midpoint-padded to YYYY-07-15, indistinguishable from an attested 15 July. Must be reverse-engineered.
